text:
```yaml
name: Spellcheck

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  spellcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install typos
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/crate-ci/typos/releases/latest/download/typos-linux-amd64.tar.gz -o typos.tar.gz
          tar -xzf typos.tar.gz
          sudo mv typos /usr/local/bin/
        shell: bash

      - name: Run typos
        run: typos
        shell: bash
```
